coordinates: right-handed Y-up external exports; Unity import/coordinate parity pending
historicalScope: Original unbranded household interpretations suitable for an around-2000 Japanese summer scene. Dimensions/manufacture are modeling assumptions, not certified historical SKU reproductions.

assets.manufacture: Assumed injection-molded PP circular frame, molded central hub/spokes and hook, 24 PP suspension links, 24 two-jaw clips with real pivot apertures and wound steel torsion springs.
assets.interfaces: Suspension links terminate inside frame/clip join volumes. Jaw pair shares a common pivot aperture axis but is separated front/back. Spring geometry wraps the pivot and extends to upper lever contact areas. Load, preload and exhaustive interpenetration/contact simulation are not verified.
assets.mounting: Hangs from modeled hook. All 24 clips are retained at every LOD; only angular/spring tessellation reduces.
assets.orientationExposure: Horizontal ring in use, hook upward, clips hang downward. Upper ring/hook sky exposed; clip interiors partly sheltered.
assets.agingCausality: Dry maintained reference. No arbitrary yellowing, cracking, rust, laundry residue or painted wear before placement/usage history exists.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Frame tubes, spokes, hook, clip jaws, real pivot holes, springs and suspension links are geometry. Molding grain and micro-roughness are material.

assets.manufacture: Assumed tubular cotton-knit ankle socks with doubled rib cuff, shaped heel/instep/toe, open cuff cavity and closed toe material volume.
components: 2 hollow knit sock shells with open cuffs and closed toes
assets.interfaces: Outer and inner surfaces join at cuff rim; inner cavity terminates at a separate inner toe cap so the opening is real. No hidden black cap. Pair shapes differ slightly to avoid obvious duplicate silhouettes.
assets.mounting: Diagnostic hanging orientation has cuff uppermost. Cloth-to-clip compression is not physics solved.
assets.orientationExposure: Dry laundered reference; outer knit exposed, inner cavity sheltered. Pair receives slightly different curvature.
assets.agingCausality: No invented dirt, holes, sweat, discoloration or laundry wear. Later wear must follow contact/laundering/exposure history.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Cuff opening, cloth thickness, heel/foot curve and toe closure are geometry. Knit loops/fibers remain material microdetail.

assets.manufacture: Assumed woven cotton square with folded perimeter hems; hanging shape includes broad gravity folds and two top-corner clip pinches.
components: single closed thin cloth material volume with folded-thickness border
assets.interfaces: Top pinch deformations indicate clip contact without duplicating clip geometry. Perimeter remains a closed material wall; stitches are not yet geometry.
assets.mounting: Diagnostic two-corner hanging state only; no wind/cloth simulation claim.
assets.orientationExposure: Dry hanging woven cloth; front/back sky exposure depends on final balcony placement.
assets.agingCausality: No baked crease dirt, fading or water marks. Later changes must follow laundering, sun and handling.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Physical cloth thickness, folded hem thickness, folds and pinches are geometry. Weave and stitching/fiber detail remain material.

materials.angularResponse: conductor response from base reflectance; no painted highlight

materials.microstructure: 128x128 knit/weave proxy; measured loop normal map pending

lodPolicy: MASTER plus LOD0/1/2/3 separate exports. Hanger keeps all 24 clips at every LOD; garments preserve real openings/thickness. Only curve/ring/grid sampling decreases.

lookdev.label: ACTUAL MESH DIAGNOSTIC - NOT UNITY - NO VISUAL FIDELITY SCORE
lookdev.method: Actual generated GLB, all submitted triangles, CPU depth buffer and one-sided backface culling. Diffuse/ambient diagnostic only.
lookdev.lightingBrief: When Unity becomes available use coherent midsummer Japanese sun, cool sky fill, contact shadow and reflections; inspect spring/pivot highlights and cloth edge transmission without baked highlights.

nextProductionTarget: If no Unity runner appears, refine the existing CottonTShirtM_Hanger sleeve/waist openings and camera-visible cloth hems instead of adding another duplicate laundry-system owner.
